name: destructive-guard
description: Jev-only PreToolUse approval gate, configured through env variables. Sends each Bash and MCP call (redacted) to the Jev classifier and asks before risky ones, and asks with a warning when Jev cannot answer; never allows or denies. Blocks .env file access. A session warning says when it is not configured or GATE_LOG cannot be written. Includes a check skill and a Lean model of the gate. Needs Python >= 3.14.
